newsitem.title: UK: Queen Elizabeth to visit India, Pakistan in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Queen Elizabeth to visit India, Pakistan in 1997.

text.p: Queen Elizabeth said on Wednesday she would visit India and Pakistan next October to mark the 50th anniversary of their independence from Britain.
The queen paid a state visit to both countries in 1961 and attended a Commonwealth summit in India in 1983.

Announcing the British government's legislative programme for the remaining six months of parliament before a general election must be held, the queen also said she would visit Canada between June 24 and July 2.

Israeli President Ezer Weizman and Brazilian President Fernando Cardoso will make state visits to Britain in February and December, respectively, the queen told both houses of parliament in a glittering, centuries-old ceremony.
Weizman, who served in the Royal Air Force during World War Two and has close links to Britain, will be the first Israeli president to pay a state visit to Britain.
